historical_scope: Original top-level measurements below describe the earlier gap task. Current city task measurements are under city_navigation; historical results are not relabelled as city results.

checks: visible ground and moving object IDs
render_cuda_smoke.host_transfers: Initialization and explicit final correctness/image readback; no end-to-end profiler claim in this record.

native_task_engineering_oracle.note: Privileged gap-steering oracle verifies task solvability and native tensor transport, not learned policy performance. No encoder inference in this measurement.

build_observations.note: Observed separate target-directory builds, not a controlled compiler benchmark; download/provisioning excluded.

learned_state_ceiling.note: Privileged-state PPO control, not a visual policy.

persistent_validation_memory.note: Reuse one validation environment/stream; avoids per-stream allocator and cuBLAS workspace retention.

vulkan_validation.regression: Direct shader stage-output constructors avoid invalid SPIR-V Offset decorations on function-local structs.

end_to_end_zero_host_staging_profile.scope: Initialized collection and PPO updates only; explicit initialization, logging and checkpoint boundaries excluded.
end_to_end_zero_host_staging_profile.limitation: CUDA Kineto activities and correlated driver/runtime calls; Vulkan draw timing is not isolated.

first_completed_visual_rl.note: Measured before the shader-output constructor portability fix; the archived native binary preserves this run's provenance.

validated_visual_rl.timing_scope: Initialization, training, validation, final evaluation and checkpointing; compilation excluded.
validated_visual_rl.note: All use the Vulkan-validation-clean native build. Simple lateral-gap task with stabilized altitude/forward speed; near-ceiling results do not establish a consistency advantage.

city_navigation.control: Kinematic fixed-altitude 6m navigation, hover or eight 3m/s goal-frame headings, automatic goal-facing camera; six 120Hz swept collision substeps per 20Hz action. Not rotor flight.
city_navigation.route_protocol: 128 blocked-direct-line, collision-free-waypoint routes in each of three spatially disjoint 64m districts. Finite 320-control-step horizon.

cpu_checks.actual_city_render_collision_geometry_ag: passed; generated-asset smoke is explicitly opt-in

privileged_route_oracle.controller: World-frame error-diffused quantization of waypoint velocity into nine commands

city_benchmark.native_scope: Kinematic control, exact collision, Vulkan culling/rasterization, sensor packing and CUDA conversion; not isolated draw time

zero_host_staging.note: Initialization, end-batch metrics and image/checkpoint export are excluded. GPU packing, conversion and rollout feature copies still occur.

matched_learned_controls.note: Matched PPO settings, transition budget, one training seed and first-episode test protocol; vision encoder remains frozen in the visual arm.

visual_inspection_rollout.note: Fixed first final-test episode, not a replacement for the aggregate estimate.
